content.rendered: “Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.” (Daniel 2: 19)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.The secret of Nebuchadnezzar’s dream was revealed to Daniel in a night vision. There was a need by the king, and the answer was revealed to Daniel. There was a challenge which the diviners and astrologers of Babylon could not deal with, and its solution was revealed to Daniel in a night vision. A solution that would distinguish Daniel was revealed. A puzzle that held the key to relevance was divinely unraveled.Friend, in this season, God will grant you divine insight and open the floodgates of divine revelation, so that you can see what others are yet to see. God will unravel the mysteries behind human challenges to you so that you can be distinguished in manifesting the solutions. God will open the portals of divine revelation so that you can download the divine solutions your generation needs.The astrologers of Babylon had no chance in decoding both the dream and interpretation, but Daniel knocked on the doors of heaven and he got answers. He may not have had the pedigree to bring forth solutions, but his access to heaven unveiled the problem and solution to him. Hear me again: you may not have the pedigree, you may not look like a solution carrier, but your access to heaven will unveil solutions to you.Your connection to heaven is a passcode to unravel the challenges of your generation. There are divine solutions waiting to be revealed to you in the place of prayer; there are solutions that nations are badly in need of, tucked away in that moment when you speak to God in prayer. There are seeds of greatness hidden in your communion with God. Some distinctions are tied to divine revelation in the secret place.Daniel and his friends sought God before the secret of Nebuchadnezzar’s dream was revealed. That voice that normally tells you not to bother with prayers is only excusing you from greatness that should arise through divine revelation.Seek that your eyes be opened; seek that heaven will unravel mysteries to you.Deuteronomy 29: 29 says: “The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.”Declare With Me: My eyes are open; I see mysteries; solutions are revealed to me, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
